title: messages.c: lichen_rpl_assigned_sf_parse expects full TLV but iterator provides data only
description: Lines 516-536: This parse function expects data to include type+length+value (3 bytes minimum), checking data[0] against LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ASSIGNED_SF and data[1] against the length. However, the standard iterator (lichen_rpl_opt_iter_next) returns out->data pointing AFTER the type/length bytes with out->data_len=1. Calling assigned_sf_parse(out->data, out->data_len, &sf) fails at line 522 with ERR_TOO_SHORT because 1 < 3. All other option parse functions (dodag_config_parse, target_parse, transit_info_parse) correctly expect data AFTER type/length, making this an API inconsistency. The function is unusable with the standard iterator pattern.
